newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-PROVINCE WIN TOSS, BAT FIRST AGAINST E.P..
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PROVINCE WIN TOSS, BAT FIRST AGAINST E.P..

text.p: Western Province captain John Commins won the toss and decided to bat first on the opening day of the four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Eastern Province at St George's Park on Friday.
Overnight and early morning rain delayed the scheduled start of play until 1:50 p.m.
An early lunch was taken with 19 overs of play lost to rain in the morning session.
Eastern Province - Gavin Victor, Michael Beamish, Louis Koen, Kepler Wessels (captain), Dave Callaghan, Mark Rushmere, Grant Morgan, Eldine Baptiste, Tim Shaw, Wikus Botha, Mornantau Haywood.
Western Province - Desmond Haynes, Sven Koenig, Jacques Kallis, H.D.Ackerman, John Commins (captain), Eric Simons, Paul Kirsten, Dave Rundle, Craig Matthews, Meyrick Pringle, Brett Schultz.
